title: What is the name and major of members who had to spend more than a hundred
question:
What is the name and major of members who had to spend more than a hundred dollars on an expense?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: full name refers to first_name, last_name; major of members refers to major_name; spend more than a hundred dollars on an expense refers to cost > 100

FROM member AS m
JOIN expense AS e ON e.XCL_022 = m.XCL_034
LEFT JOIN major AS maj ON maj.XCL_030 = m.XCL_042
WHERE e.XCL_020 > 100
